newsitem.title: USA: Sandwich Bank holders vote holding company.
newsitem.headline: Sandwich Bank holders vote holding company.

text.p: Sandwich Co-operative Bank on Thursday said stockholders approved the formation of a holding company with the bank as principal subsidiary.
Under the move, approved at its annual meeting Wednesday, each share of the bank's common stock will be converted into one share of stock in the holding company, the bank said.
Implementation of the plan is subject to regulatory approval. Sandwich Co-operative has $475 million in assets.
